choice_prompt:2:1711116001.text: Ouch... Thank you. If you had come any later, I might have had my neck bitten off by those long-tailed bandits...
choice_prompt:2:1711116001.source_cn: 嗷呜……谢谢你。要是你再晚来一会儿，我可能就要被那群长尾巴的强盗咬断脖子了……

choice_prompt:5:1711116003.text: That was the reward I'd worked so hard to earn; it was oily and smelled delicious. I couldn't bear to eat it...
choice_prompt:5:1711116003.source_cn: 那可是我好不容易才赚到的报酬，油汪汪的、香喷喷的。我都舍不得吃……

say:8:1711116006:1.text: My stomach was growling with hunger, so I agreed.
say:8:1711116006:1.source_cn: 我肚子饿得咕咕叫，就答应它了。

choice_prompt:10:1711116007.text: Ouch! You have no idea how dangerous it was! I risked being caught and skinned alive, jumping around under the carriage wheels, and almost turned into a meat pie several times...
choice_prompt:10:1711116007.source_cn: 嗷！你是不知道多危险！我冒着被抓住剥皮的风险，在马车轱辘下面跳来跳去，好几次差点变成肉饼……

choice_prompt:13:1711116009.text: Taking advantage of their size and numbers, they pinned me to the ground and robbed me, tearing out a lot of fur from my tail!
choice_prompt:13:1711116009.source_cn: 它们仗着个头大、数量多，直接把我按在地上抢，我的尾巴都被扯掉了好多毛！

say:14:1711116010:1.text: That…that beautiful big fox? I don’t know. It gave me the meat and then ran away.
say:14:1711116010:1.source_cn: 那个……那个好看的大狐狸？我不知道。它把肉给我就跑掉了。

choice_prompt:17:1711116012.text: Kind wolf, if you see it again... could you tell it that next time it needs a replacement, could it have three legs? Its current two legs are all eaten by mice... Awooo...
choice_prompt:17:1711116012.source_cn: 好心的狼，如果你再见到它……能不能告诉它，下次找替身能不能给三个腿？现在的两个腿都喂老鼠了……嗷呜……

choice:13:0:1.text: Where is the fox who asked you for help?

choice:13:1:2.text: I'll go ask him if he has any leftover turkey legs.
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 我去问问他还有没有剩下的火鸡腿

choice:10:1:2.text: I think I know who you're talking about.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 我大概知道你说的是谁了
